mappings.note: This verse contains the title/superscription (To the choirmaster, Miktam of David, Do not destroy, when he fled from Saul). The OSMAIN text includes this content in the header before v1, but does not number it as a separate verse. Therefore, there is no matching numbered verse in OSMAIN.
The translation includes the phrase 'until the calamities have passed' (jusqu'à ce que les calamités soient passées) which is not present in OSMAIN v1.

extraContent.description: Superscription/Title text (Au maître-chantre... devant Saül) is present in the translation as verse 1 but is unnumbered header text in OSMAIN.
Phrase: 'jusqu'à ce que les calamités soient passées' (until the calamities have passed). This phrase appears at the end of v2 in the translation but is absent from OSMAIN v1.
